reason: A client-side DeepSeek Harness Web plugin that visually highlights rendered Markdown text by part of speech, with theme-aware styling, filters, streaming compatibility, and code-block exclusions.

summaries.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness Web 界面中按词性为已渲染的 Markdown 文本着色或添加背景高亮，并提供主题、筛选和流式内容适配设置。
summaries.en: Highlights rendered Markdown text by part of speech in the DeepSeek Harness Web interface with configurable themes, filters, decoration styles, and streaming-content support.

capabilities: Client-side DOM post-processing of rendered Markdown content
Part-of-speech segmentation and color or background highlighting for Chinese and English text
Theme-aware styling with configurable filters and decoration modes
MutationObserver-based updates for streaming and dynamically rendered content
Settings for enabling highlighting, languages, containers, and display options
